deck.note: shuffled deck, only server knows order

trick.note: cards played to the current trick

taken.note: tricks won by this player, face up for scoring

pass_staging.note: cards selected for passing before reveal to recipient

phases.name: deal
phases.note: shuffle and deal 13 cards to each player

phases.name: pass
phases.note: pass 3 cards: left, right, across, hold (rotates each round)

phases.name: scoring
phases.note: hearts=1pt each, queen of spades=13pts, shoot the moon inverts

follow_suit.definition: must play a card of the led suit if able
follow_suit.constraint: if player has card of led suit, must play it

hearts_broken.definition: cannot lead hearts until a heart has been played to a trick
hearts_broken.constraint: if leading and hearts not broken, cannot lead hearts unless only hearts in hand

no_points_first_trick.definition: cannot play hearts or queen of spades on the first trick
no_points_first_trick.constraint: on first trick, cannot play hearts or queen of spades unless only such cards in hand

two_of_clubs_leads.definition: the player holding the 2 of clubs leads the first trick
two_of_clubs_leads.constraint: first trick must be led with 2 of clubs

shoot_the_moon.definition: if one player takes all 26 penalty points, every other player gets 26 instead
shoot_the_moon.effect: if player.penalty_points == 26 then other_players.score += 26 else player.score += player.penalty_points

library.hearts_broken: any card with suit:hearts has been played to a trick this round

end_conditions.condition: any player score >= 100 and this player has lowest score
end_conditions.name: lowest_score_wins

end_conditions.condition: any player score >= 100 and this player has highest score
end_conditions.name: highest_score_loses
